description: Update the authenticated bot's global avatar or banner. Provide at least one field. Omitted fields keep their current value. Pass null to clear an image.

avatar.description: PNG, JPEG, or GIF avatar as a base64 data URI or Discord CDN URL. Pass null to clear.

banner.description: PNG, JPEG, or GIF banner as a base64 data URI or Discord CDN URL. Pass null to clear.

name: discord_update_bot_profile
title: Update the Bot's Global Profile
